text: Human Rights Watch reports that Kazakhstan continues to restrict freedoms of expression, association and assembly, prosecutes critics on overbroad 'extremism' charges, and has failed to fully investigate the January 2022 protests that left 238 dead and where detainees were tortured; the UN Human Rights Committee raised serious concerns about torture and use of force against civil society.
short: Kazakhstan: restricted freedoms, torture, unpunished January 2022 deaths
